summary: Comprehensive testing completed for ROI calculator pivot and self-serve conversion features. Backend API regression passed (29/30 tests, 96.7%). Frontend ROI calculator with numeric inputs, package comparison, mocked app access (register/AppStore/GooglePlay), contact form, 3-step workflow, and responsive design all tested successfully. All 28 localized routes working with proper redirects and SEO.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Rate limiting triggered during rapid test submissions (Test 13 got 429)
flaky_endpoints.impact: Expected behavior - rate limiter working correctly (5 submissions per 10 minutes per IP)
flaky_endpoints.workaround: This is intentional protection, not a bug. Test suite creates 6 leads in quick succession.
